rapport_notes: Patient with a customer who repeatedly misheard/misunderstood questions; responded to the price objection with a best-value-day nudge rather than pressure.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do we have any specific concerns or any important things that you wanted to address on this call today?" -- asked after move date and house/apartment type were already probed.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: "No, no, no, no, no." -- no concern raised.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if you still have extra time in moving some of the items... the less time you take the less money end up spending" -- self-prep tip clearly delivered.

top_strength: Gave a fully personalized estimate anchor (house-to-apartment, one bedroom worth of items, distance) rather than a generic range.
coaching_note: Customer stalled with 'I need to pick on it, I'll call you back' without a real close attempt being made -- try an explicit ask (e.g. 'would you like me to lock that in?') before letting the call end open-ended.
